notes: Reworked the player controls for the remote. The 10-second skip buttons are gone - seeking now happens on the progress bar itself: press Down from Play/Pause to reach it, then Left or Right. A single press moves 5 seconds, and holding the direction speeds up the longer you hold, so you can cross a whole movie in a couple of seconds. The controls also stay on screen for 4 seconds instead of disappearing almost immediately, and whenever they fade away the remote is put back on the Play/Pause button.
